title: Mirror transform over SAE feature space
hypothesis: On four held-out relation tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, a small orthogonal Givens View applied to sparse SAE feature activations can retain explicit-FV causal quality, keep post-transform activations sparse, and improve the quality/byte frontier over native SAE top-k, global sparse coding, and LoReFT at comparable intervention dimension.

task.type: pretrained causal-LM relation recall with residual-stream interventions
task.sae_shape: tied encoder [2048,512] with decoder atoms equal to encoder rows

physical_object: one pinned Pythia-70m and its shared 2048-atom layer-3 SAE
mirror_insertion: Apply a fixed sparse pairwise Givens transform to each sparse SAE activation vector before tied-decoder reconstruction; only angles and sparse activation codes vary by task.
mirror_coordinate: up to 16 FP16 Givens angles in a 32-dimensional active feature subspace; all transformed nonzeros, indices, angles, and metadata are charged.
controls: Native SAE encoder activations with top-eight positive features
Global-dictionary signed matching pursuit with eight atoms
Untransformed shared SAE sparse code with matched active dimension
Mirror Givens transform over the sparse feature code

split.fresh_open_rule: Open only after both dev seeds meet the quality, sparsity, and byte gates; freeze all transform and scale settings before opening. Fresh IDs and seeds are fixed here.

development.selection_metric: mean dev gold-token log-probability uplift subject to sparsity and byte gates

success_gate: On every fresh task and seed: retain at least 90% of explicit-FV uplift, lose at most 0.05 accuracy, stay within 2x native top-eight SAE active features, and use <=0.5x explicit incremental bytes. Mirror must outperform untransformed sparse and LoReFT controls at byte-near cost or show a distinct Pareto point.
failure_gate: Dev cannot satisfy the quality/sparsity/byte gates, or Mirror is dominated by native sparse coding or LoReFT at byte-near cost.
boundaries: Four relation tasks and one pinned model/layer only.
Fresh task IDs/seeds cannot tune settings.
Sparse activations and task-aligned function vectors do not establish broad behavior capacity.
